concept.title: Nutanix Objects Storage
concept.shortdesc: You can configure Red Hat Quay to use Nutanix Objects Storage as an object storage backend. Use this example to set credentials, bucket details, and connection options for private cloud infrastructure.

conbody.codeblock: DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_CONFIG: nutanixStorage: # storage config name - RadosGWStorage # actual driver - access_key: <access_key> secret_key: <secret_key> bucket_name: <bucket_name> hostname: <hostname> is_secure: 'true' port: '443' storage_path: /datastorage/registry DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_DEFAULT_LOCATIONS: [] DISTRIBUTED_STORAGE_PREFERENCE: # must contain name of the storage config - nutanixStorage
